about: Phase 0 seed set for the request interpreter (reports/TMCode prompt interpreter layer.md, Q14). Each case: the request, its language, whether it is already clear (a control the interpreter must not make worse), the task type, and a hidden spec (words a faithful card's spec must carry). Kinyarwanda and code-mixed requests are hand-written drafts: a Kinyarwanda-speaking teacher must review them (QD7), and real student prompts (with consent, QD8) replace them in Phase 0.
